question: Which play format has the most banned card-printing records? Give that format and the distinct names of its banned cards.
gold_sql: SELECT format, name FROM ( SELECT l.format, c.name, MIN(c.uuid) AS sort_uuid FROM legalities AS l JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE l.status = 'Banned' AND l.format = ( SELECT format FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, format LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY l.format, c.name ) AS banned_names ORDER BY sort_uuid
predicted_sql:
WITH banned_counts AS (
    SELECT l.format AS format, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY l.format
),
top_format AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM banned_counts
    WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM banned_counts)
)
SELECT l.format AS format,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.name) AS banned_cards
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
JOIN top_format t ON t.format = l.format
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
GROUP BY l.format
model_text:
